reason: Both conversations correctly deliver the critical safety stop (stop using, unplug, don't keep resetting, get an engineer/electrician) and both make the same unsupported leap to 'magnetron or capacitor' without mentioning the more probable door interlock/latch fault or asking whether the RCD trips with the microwave unplugged.
